name: Reaver’s Net
body:
Aura faint transmutation; CL 5th; Slot none; Price 12,600 gp; Weight 10 lbs.

DESCRIPTION

This magical net is made from supple green cords of specially treated seaweed. The cords are studded with tiny suckers, hooks, and tendrils that constantly seethe and roil as if the net were underwater. A reaver’s net functions as a +1 net for all users.

Its powers truly awaken when its wielder has the Weapon Specialization (net) feat, at least 7 ranks in Profession (sailor), or at least 1 level of the sea reaver prestige class. In the hands of such a wielder the net takes on a life of its own, functioning as a +1 net of distance. Additionally, any creature entangled by the net must make a Fortitude save (DC 14) each round the entanglement persists to avoid being paralyzed for 3d6 minutes. The semi-living nature of the net allows the trained user to refold the net for proper throwing as a move action.

CONSTRUCTION REQUIREMENTS

Feats Craft Magic Arms and Armor, clairaudience/clairvoyance, entangle, hold person; Cost 6,300 gp.
